items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 22 November 2026 7:30am
items.description:
##Today##

Dry today with the patchy cloud allowing sunny spells. Windy for most of the day with the strong easterlies making it feel cold, the winds only slowly easing later in afternoon and in the evening. Maximum temperature 9°C. Comments: Risk of coastal overtopping in places this morning (high tide approx. 9am). Strong winds.

##Tomorrow##

Staying dry for most of Monday, although areas of cloud affecting the island at times. Rain arriving towards the end of the day and overnight into Tuesday. Moderate or fresh southeast winds, strengthening later, becoming strong, the maximum temperature 9°C. Comments: Coastal overtopping in places at high tide (approx. 9:50 AM, and 10:15 PM). Strong winds.
